content.value_statement: AI-assisted writing often becomes vague, inflated, or hard to scan. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code produce direct prose for real readers.
actual_capabilities: Applies active voice, positive form, concrete language, and concision rules from The Elements of Style.
Improves documentation, README text, commit messages, pull request summaries, error messages, and UI copy.
Identifies common AI writing patterns such as puffery, vague adjectives, and empty phrasing.
Guides the assistant to load only the most relevant reference file for the writing task.
Provides before-and-after editing patterns for shorter, clearer prose.
limitations: It is style guidance, not a full grammar checker or fact checker.
Some historical examples use older language and may need modern editorial judgment.
It does not enforce a brand voice unless the user provides one.
It does not edit files automatically unless the user asks for file changes.

use_cases.title: Sharpen Technical Documentation
use_cases.description: Turn long explanations into direct steps, clearer paragraphs, and more useful README sections.

use_cases.title: Clean Up Product Copy
use_cases.description: Remove inflated claims from UI text, help content, and release notes while preserving meaning.

use_cases.title: Improve Team Communication
use_cases.description: Write concise commit messages, pull request descriptions, status updates, and incident summaries.

prompt_templates.title: Edit a Short Draft
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner revision for a short message or paragraph.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to edit the following text for clarity and concision. Keep the meaning unchanged: [paste text]

prompt_templates.title: Rewrite Documentation
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to rewrite this documentation section. Prefer active voice, concrete terms, and short paragraphs: [paste section]

prompt_templates.title: Remove AI Writing Patterns
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate cleanup for prose that sounds generic.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to identify AI writing patterns in this draft, then provide a cleaner revision: [paste draft]

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Complete Writing Flow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review across several related outputs.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to review these commit messages, pull request notes, and release notes. Return concise revisions and explain the main style changes: [paste materials]

best_practices: Provide the audience, goal, and any required tone before asking for a rewrite.
Ask for both the revision and a short explanation when you need to learn the edits.
Use the skill on final drafts to remove vague claims, passive voice, and needless words.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for generic polish without explaining the target reader or purpose.
Do not use the skill to make unsupported claims sound more convincing.
Do not accept every historical style rule when modern inclusive language needs a different choice.

faq.question: What does this skill improve?
faq.answer: It improves prose clarity, sentence strength, concision, and specific word choice.

faq.question: Can it write new documentation?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the facts, audience, and desired structure so it can draft clear documentation.

faq.question: Does it replace a grammar checker?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on style, clarity, and AI pattern avoidance, not exhaustive grammar validation.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it use external services?
faq.answer: No evidence found. The skill is Markdown guidance and reference material.

faq.question: When should I load extra reference files?
faq.answer: Load them when a task needs detailed rules for grammar, composition, formatting, or word choice.
